_dynamics_notes: Activity-based (eq 1-2): RG centers add INaP; C=10pF, gL 4.5/2.8 nS, gNaP 4.5 nS, gSyn 10 nS, EL -62.5/-60, ENa 50, ESynE -10, ESynI -75, Vthr -50, Vmax 0, V1/2,m -40/km -6, V1/2,h -45/kh 4, tau_h bell 150-400 ms (k_tau NOT verified), dt 1 ms, OU noise. Drive D=d*alpha+b: F centers carry the speed slope (d=0.1,b=0), E centers tonic bias (d=0,b=0.1), V0D dI=0.75, V0V dI=0.15 (hind). TRAP: our port keeps tau_h FIXED ~350 ms (params.py rg_nap_h=0.35) - collapsing tau_h(V) quenches half-centers. Injury levers (Table 2/3) are drive/weight scalings, not rewiring.

Also excluded: RG-E->i-Sh2 0.5 (Sh2 outputs are inter-girdle only).
